Label: Strong fit
Criteria: Predicate is a simple yes/no or threshold; trusted issuer already exists (gov CA, bank, employer); high frequency; verifier currently over-collects sensitive data; no legal requirement to retain the full document.

Label: Good fit
Criteria: Same as 5, but either frequency is medium, or predicate needs one extra field (e.g. selective disclosure of a category, not pure boolean).

Label: Possible / needs design
Criteria: Predicate is more complex (range, multi-source match) or the issuer ecosystem is fragmented (multiple CAs/counties); still worth prototyping.

Label: Weak fit
Criteria: Verifier has a legal duty to retain full data (KYC/AML) so ZK only reduces exposure in transit, not at rest; or frequency is low.

Label: Poor fit
Criteria: The moment inherently requires full document content (e.g. a printed certificate to be physically inspected) or requires human judgment beyond a provable predicate.
